name: student_full_name
description: Full legal name of the student, as provided by the guardian during onboarding.

name: date_of_birth
description: Student date of birth, used to confirm eligibility for the supported age range.

name: has_diagnosed_learning_difficulty
description: True if the student has a formally diagnosed learning difficulty on file.

name: requires_one_on_one_support
description: True if the student requires a dedicated one-on-one Learning Support Assistant.

name: guardian_full_name
description: Full legal name of the parent or guardian submitting the onboarding form.

name: guardian_email
description: Email address of the parent or guardian, used for account and communication purposes.

name: guardian_phone_number
description: Phone number of the parent or guardian in E.164 international format.

name: preferred_session_language
description: Language the family prefers for Learning Support Assistant sessions.

name: consent_to_data_processing
description: True if the guardian has explicitly consented to data processing, required to complete onboarding.

name: emergency_contact_provided
description: True if a valid emergency contact has been provided for the student.

name: session_frequency_per_week
description: Number of Learning Support Assistant sessions requested per week, between one and five.

name: region
description: Geographic region used by the Row-Level Security policy to scope analytics reader access.

name: ingestion_timestamp
description: Timestamp at which the record was written into the staged and enforced dataset.
